rationale: The first-event status bar is already substantially covered by the Onboarding specs (received via standard fluentbit + metrics/traces + keyword card; rejected via 401; no-requests via 120s auto; stopped + pill via clock mock; next-visit notice; flag-off), but (a) those specs are not registered in any ci_matrix.json shard so they do not run in the CI shard for this feature, and (b) the feature doc and run-context label the feature 'area: Streams', whose shard globs already own web/src/components/ingestion/** and pages/generalPages/firstEventPage.js. Three WIRED behaviors remain uncovered: the test-guide (curl, kind=test) received path with 'Connect your real source', the idle -> Check now -> received flow (Workflow 2), and the instant no-requests diagnosis via the Troubleshoot click (trigger=troubleshoot, vs the 120s auto path). A new Streams spec is created to cover only these gaps and is registered into the existing 'Streams' shard; the Onboarding specs are left as-is to avoid duplication.
